DisplayName.Value: Contour Plus — Topography & Road Grade Analyzer

ShortDescription.Value: Contour overlays and terrain-planning measurements with configurable intervals.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — advanced measurements need broader runtime testing.
WHAT IT DOES Displays terrain contour lines and terrain/road-grade planning readouts.
HOW TO USE Open Contour Plus and enable contours. Adjust available interval and visibility controls in the panel or Options. Disable the overlay to hide the lines.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Contours are off by default. Large height ranges may increase the effective interval to keep overlay work bounded. Terrain sampling and advanced profile/earthwork values are planning aids, not surveying guarantees.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.2.5-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Connected display settings to the live overlay, persist panel changes, lower redraw frequency and cap segment work. Removed fabricated initial measurements and corrected settings registration.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
